capabilities: Record voice or meeting audio from the ribbon with a waveform mini recorder
Transcribe audio in the cloud into Markdown notes
Write the finished note into the vault
Capture audio outside Obsidian via an optional Apple Shortcut
extras: Cloud processing is free only for a 7-day trial, then paid via Whop. The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; privacy policy, terms of service, and a network disclosure (PRIVACY.md) are referenced. Requires leaving Obsidian open (or reopening later) so finished notes sync into the vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn voice recordings or meeting audio into written Markdown notes.

requires.name: Enot cloud processing (7-day trial, then paid via Whop)

summary: Voice and meeting audio recorder that sends recordings to a cloud service and writes transcribed Markdown notes into the vault.
